text:
alex: Anyone hit this when running the edge sample locally? `import` fails with "Could not resolve '@redwood/inference-sdk'" only when using `vercel dev` inside the monorepo. Works if I `pnpm -w build` first.

maria: probably workspace hoisting + exports. Does the sdk package have `exports` set?

alex: yep, exports only points to ./dist/index.mjs and we set "type": "module". In packages the dist exists but vercel's resolver seems to look at the root package.json or follow symlinks differently.

sam: FYI esbuild (used by vercel dev) resolves packages by reading package.json at the symlink root, not the realfs path. pnpm makes `node_modules/.pnpm/.../node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk` symlinked, so relative paths in exports can break.

liam: common fixes: 1) add an explicit `exports` subpath like "./index": "./dist/index.mjs" and import from `@redwood/inference-sdk/index` (annoying), or 2) provide a dev-only `dev:src` entry that points to src via an mjs re-export, or 3) alias in Vite.

alex: tried aliasing in vite: `resolve.alias['@redwood/inference-sdk'] = '/workspace/packages/sdk/src'` and that works, but we shouldn't require this for new devs.

maria: can we instead publish a tiny `dev.mjs` at package root that does `export * from './src/index.js'` and add it to `exports` under a `./dev` key? Then sample-app's dev script could set `NODE_ENV=development` and the bundler would pick `./dev` if we add a small `package.json` hint?

liam: bundlers won't magically pick nonstandard keys. But we can add a top-level `browser` / `module` field that points to `dev.mjs` in the monorepo for dev builds. Or simpler: make a `package.json` script `pnpm -w link-dev` that programmatically writes a shallow package.json into node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk with `main: ../../packages/sdk/src/index.js` for dev only. Ugly but effective.

sam: also watch types: TS imports can still resolve to `dist` d.ts. If we point to src we need to ensure path mapping in tsconfig: `paths: { "@redwood/*": ["packages/*/src"] }` so editors pick up types. Otherwise new hires will get broken intellisense.

alex: good call. adding tsconfig path mapping fixed my vscode hype.

ci-bot: Repro added: clean container, pnpm -w i, pnpm --filter sample-app dev => fails. Suggested CI check: `pnpm --filter sample-app test:dev-resolve` that runs Vite build in the container.

maria: action items: 1) small repo script `scripts/dev-link.js` that can create dev symlink or shallow package in node_modules for quickdev; 2) update dev onboarding doc with `pnpm --filter sample-app dev:link` + tsconfig paths snippet; 3) add a fast CI smoke for dev resolution.

liam: I'll take the dev-link script. Sam can add tsconfig doc. Alex can PR onboarding.

alex: thanks! will add a short note: "If you see module resolution errors with vercel/wrangler dev, try `pnpm --filter sample-app dev:link` or run `pnpm -w build` before `vercel dev`."

ci-bot: Note: when adding scripts that mutate node_modules, add a clear `--danger` flag and gate it in docs.

sam: one more tip: consider adding a lightweight `packageExports: { dev: './dev.mjs' }` script that rewrites package.json to include a `exports['./dev']` for local runs only. Cleaner than mutating node_modules.

alex: cool. will post a PR with dev-link script + docs. thanks everyone.
